description: This file contains shell script functions and variables related to wireless network interface configuration and management, intended for use with netifd in an OpenWRT or similar embedded system environment.

methods.name: add_driver
methods.description: Placeholder function for adding wireless drivers, overridden during driver setup.

methods.name: wireless_setup_vif_failed
methods.description: Reports failure to set up a wireless virtual interface.

methods.name: wireless_setup_failed
methods.description: Handles general wireless device setup failures.

methods.name: prepare_key_wep
methods.description: Prepares WEP keys, converting them to hex format if necessary.

methods.name: _wdev_prepare_channel
methods.description: Configures wireless channel, band, and hardware mode based on json data.

methods.name: _wdev_handler
methods.description: Dispatcher to call driver-specific interface functions based on json configuration.

methods.name: _wdev_msg_call
methods.description: Temporarily sets json namespace and calls a given command.

methods.name: _wdev_wrapper
methods.description: Defines wrapper functions for various wireless commands.

methods.name: _wdev_notify_init
methods.description: Initializes a JSON object for notification with command and device info.

methods.name: _wdev_notify
methods.description: Sends a notification via ubus with the JSON-encoded data.

methods.name: _wdev_add_variables
methods.description: Adds variables to JSON object from key=value pairs.

methods.name: _wireless_add_vif
methods.description: Adds a wireless virtual interface configuration.

methods.name: _wireless_add_vlan
methods.description: Adds VLAN configuration for wireless interfaces.

methods.name: _wireless_set_up
methods.description: Sends a command to bring wireless interface up.

methods.name: _wireless_set_data
methods.description: Sets wireless interface data/configuration.

methods.name: _wireless_add_process
methods.description: Reports a new process related to wireless setup.

methods.name: _wireless_process_kill_all
methods.description: Kills all wireless-related processes with optional signal.

methods.name: _wireless_set_retry
methods.description: Configures retry count for wireless operations.

methods.name: wireless_vif_parse_encryption
methods.description: Parses encryption settings and determines security configurations for wireless interfaces.

methods.name: _wireless_set_brsnoop_isolation
methods.description: Configures bridge snooping and isolation features based on parameters.

methods.name: for_each_interface
methods.description: Iterates over all wireless interfaces and applies a specified function.

methods.name: for_each_vlan
methods.description: Iterates over VLANs and applies a specified function.

methods.name: for_each_station
methods.description: Iterates over registered stations and applies a specified function.

methods.name: init_wireless_driver
methods.description: Initializes wireless driver with dump setup or standard setup/teardown commands.
